Search Layouts - The Difference Between List, Grid And Map View
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000681551

## It is possible to control whether the member search result pages, and post types pages display results in list, grid or map view. This is done to personalize the website and to provide better user experience. Here are the different type of views visitors can select:
It is possible to control whether the member search result pages, and post types pages display results in list, grid or map view. This is done to personalize the website and to provide better user experience. Here are the different type of views visitors can select:
- Grid View ( Grid View Search Results )
List View

## Member Search Layout
This setting applies to Member Search Results. There are 3 options:
• Starts in List View
• Starts in Grid View
• Starts in Map View Add-on

## Post Search Layout
This setting applies to Post Types Search Results. There are 2 options:
• Starts in List View
• Starts in Grid View
